text: Straight-up, the model went 12-4 on graded games this week. Against the spread, it beat the market's own line on 1 of the 16 games where the two actually disagreed. The clearest win this week: PIT over ATL, a 1.7-point disagreement with the market that came in right. The tougher result to swallow: LAC was favored at 83% over ARI, and ARI won instead. On player props, the model hit 142 of 193 graded picks. Best prop call: Malik Nabers anytime TD, where the model's own number was furthest from the market's and Malik Nabers didn't score, as projected.

Straight-up, the model went 9-5 on graded games this week. Against the spread, it beat the market's own line on 1 of the 14 games where the two actually disagreed. The model's best call of the week: KC over IND, a 5.0-point disagreement with the market that came in right. The one that didn't work out: TB was favored at 78% over CLE, and CLE won instead.
